title: Parker as a normal, good boy in Kansas City
summary: Smith describes the young Parker as quiet, agreeable and unlike what he became.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Charlie Parker: encounters, lore and legacy

blocks.x: But is there anything to suggest in Charlie Parker's sort of youth, when you first met him... Did he seem to be an unstable kind of guy?
No. He was a normal man, normal boy. Good boy.
Because his behavior really became very peculiar later on.

Yeah, he was a good boy. He was like that with me down in Kansas City. A good boy, good to get along with, agreeable with anything you wanted to do -- it was all right with him. He changed after he got foolin' with that (?) around that big company. Because Lester Young didn't smoke, he didn't drink.
He didn't do nothin' like that. He didn't fool with that stuff.
